test_title: PYST 51: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 04 Sept, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which Indian leader emphasised a 'Nation First' ethos during a seminar in Lucknow in May 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Yogi Adityanath**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Yogi Adityanath, the Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh, is known for his strong emphasis on nationalism and the "Nation First" ethos.
 
• During a seminar in Lucknow in May 2025, he highlighted the importance of prioritizing national interests above individual or regional interests.
 
• He reiterated that development, unity, and cultural preservation must align with the vision of a strong, self-reliant India.
 
• Yogi Adityanath has frequently propagated the "Nation First" ideology in various spheres, promoting government policies that strengthen national security and social harmony.
 
• The seminar focused on the role of leadership in promoting values of patriotism and national integration in the socio-political landscape.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Amit Shah**

 
 
• Amit Shah is the Union Home Minister of India and a prominent leader of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP).
 
• He is known for his role in the abrogation of Article 370 in Jammu and Kashmir and the introduction of the Citizenship Amendment Act (CAA).
 
• His contributions focus on national security, internal affairs, and policy reforms.
 
 
 
• **Rajnath Singh**
 
 
• Rajnath Singh is the Union Minister of Defence of India and a senior leader in the BJP.
 
• He has been instrumental in strengthening India's defense capabilities and promoting indigenization in defense manufacturing under the "Atmanirbhar Bharat" initiative.
 
• He has also served as the Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh and the Union Home Minister in the past.
 
 
 
• **Narendra Modi**
 
 
• As the Prime Minister of India, Narendra Modi has been a strong proponent of the "Nation First" ideology.
 
• He has launched several landmark initiatives such as Digital India, Make in India, and Swachh Bharat Abhiyan, all aimed at strengthening India's global standing and development.
 
• His leadership is characterized by a focus on economic growth, nationalism, and inclusive governance.
